check.title: Would you pass? Find out in 2 minutes
check.intro: 10 questions about how your company actually works. Your answers stay in your browser unless you choose to send them.

probation-minor.q: Have you ever set a probation period for an employee under 18?
probation-minor.why: Probation may not be set for minors.

probation-transfer.q: Have you ever set probation for an employee who joined by transfer from another employer?
probation-transfer.why: No probation applies to an employee transferred by agreement between employers.

probation-max.q: Is every probation period 3 months or shorter (apart from the special cases the law allows)?
probation-max.why: Probation normally may not exceed 3 months, or 12 in special cases.

probation-ending.q: Do you track probation end dates and, if you let someone go, give at least 3 days' written notice?
probation-ending.why: Ending a contract during probation requires at least 3 days' written notice.

fixed-term-ground.q: Does every fixed-term contract state its lawful ground?
fixed-term-ground.why: A fixed-term contract may only be concluded on a ground the law allows.

fixed-term-ending.q: Do you know in advance when your fixed-term contracts end?
fixed-term-ending.why: Letting the end date slip by can leave the legal status unclear. A lawyer must confirm the consequences.

termination-ground.q: Does every dismissal order state its ground?
termination-ground.why: The ground for ending an employment contract must be stated.

annual-leave-min.q: Does every employee get at least 20 working days of annual leave a year (24 on a six-day week)?
annual-leave-min.why: Minimum annual leave is 20 working days, or 24 on a six-day week.

leave-cash-swap.q: Have you ever paid cash instead of annual leave to an employee who stays with you?
leave-cash-swap.why: As a rule, annual leave may not be replaced by money, except when employment ends.

notice-period.q: When you dismiss someone, do you give notice by length of service (14–60 days, 2 months for staff cuts)?
notice-period.why: The notice period depends on length of service; for a reduction in staff it is 2 months.

result.title: Your result

good.d: The main risks are under control. Tesuch helps you stay here every day, not just today.

mid.d: A few points could become a problem during an inspection. Start with the ones below.

low.d: An inspection would very likely find violations. It's worth starting the fixes now.

result.unsureNote: “Not sure” is a risk too: better to find out before an inspection does.
result.advisory: Advisory: not yet verified by a lawyer
result.disclaimer: This self-check is for information only and is not legal advice. Talk to a lawyer before making a decision.
